widgets_values: A low-angle close-up photograph of a vintage retro coin-operated arcade machine outdoors at a carnival on a bright sunny day. The machine features a large circular chrome metallic frame with a glass window. The glass reflection shows a giant colorful Ferris wheel and amusement park rides under a clear light-blue sky. Red retro LED digital display behind the glass. Soft pastel pink body with light blue controls and silver chrome details. Warm sunlight, golden hour lighting, cinematic vintage film aesthetic, shot on 35mm film, Kodachrome color style, shallow depth of field, high detail, photorealistic
